question_text: What's our current SOC 2 compliance posture?
gold_answer_text: Our SOC 2 posture shows 4 of 6 sampled controls passing (CC6.1, CC7.1) and 2 failing or flagged for review (CC6.6, CC7.2 partial); see the linked findings for the full evidence trail.

Four controls currently fail: CC6.6 (unrestricted inbound access on management ports), IA-2 (13% of legacy-VPN accounts lack MFA), RA-5 (Critical CVEs open past the remediation SLA), and CM-7 (unjustified Telnet/FTP services on 9 production servers).

question_text: Why did our compliance score drop this week?
gold_answer_text: The score dropped because CC6.6 and IA-2 moved to fail this week (unrestricted inbound firewall rules found, and legacy-VPN MFA gap confirmed), and two controls (CC8.1, AU-2) were downgraded to insufficient_evidence after their supporting evidence was found to be over a year stale.

question_text: How is the compliance score calculated?
gold_answer_text: Each framework's controls are weighted by severity category (Critical/High/Medium/Low); the score divides passing weighted controls by total weighted controls in scope. Controls flagged insufficient_evidence are excluded from the numerator but still count in the denominator, so unresolved gaps pull the score down rather than being ignored.
